verdict.rationale: Warp does expose an OpenAPI spec (warp-probe-2) and API/CLI reference docs (warp-docs-63, warp-probe-3), so the axis of an API reference applies given Warp's platform ambitions (warp-docs-42). However, there is no evidence of an interactive reference UI with runnable/'try it out' examples — the pack only shows a raw openapi.json file and static CLI reference pages, not an interactive explorer.
